art_direction: Industrial Brutalism & High-Fashion Editorial. Emphasizes immense scale, precision, engineered power, and premium quality. It avoids 'SaaS blue' and standard generic layouts, replacing them with monolithic typography, architectural grid structures, and cinematic lighting.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[8vw] font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight
hierarchy.overline_chapters: font-mono text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-orange-500

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing.
Never center paragraphs. Optical alignment over geometric.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers/surfaces; use glassmorphism.
Use #FF4500 sparingly (kinetic trigger for interactions, active states, progress indicators).

grids_and_layouts.hero: Full height (h-screen) with absolute positioned 3D canvas (z-10). Typography positioned behind (z-0) and in front (z-20) to create immense depth.

sections.numbered_chapters: Each section starts with an IBM Plex Mono chapter marker like '[01] MOBILE CRANES'.
sections.bento_fleet: Asymmetric bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8). Mix col-span-8 and col-span-4 to create tension.
sections.photography: Spotlight effect. Clipped frames (sharp 1px border-white/10, p-4 padding around the image within the card). Images must feel like physical prints.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Container padding px-6 md:px-12.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Lenis (smooth momentum scroll). Mandatory for the premium feel.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal. Wrap lines in overflow-hidden divs, translate Y from 100% to 0% using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial marquee. Font: Cabinet Grotesk, massive outline text (text-8xl text-transparent border-white/20 style webkit-text-stroke) or slow organic ribbon.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveals: Framer motion whileInView. Subtle y-axis lift (y: 40) and opacity fade.

3d_and_creative_components.scene_setup: Use <Canvas> with <Environment preset='city'> or 'warehouse'. Crucial: Add <SpotLight> for cinematic shadows on the crane models.
3d_and_creative_components.interaction: Use <PresentationControls> or <OrbitControls> (restricted angles) so users can rotate the crane. Add small glowing HTML hotspots (<Html> from drei) pointing to crane specs.
3d_and_creative_components.fallback: If no 3D model (.gltf/.glb) is available, use highly stylized abstract 3D geometric shapes to represent a crane structure, OR construct a layered 3D parallax effect using Drei's <Image> and <ScrollControls>.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required libraries: framer-motion, lenis (or @studio-freight/react-lenis), three, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, lucide-react.
Build the hero section with a kinetic, masked text reveal (framer-motion). The text should say something like 'ENGINEERED POWER' in massive typography. Layer it behind/around the 3D canvas.

Implement an interactive 3D model canvas using @react-three/fiber. Use a stylized industrial representation (or basic three.js primitives creatively arranged as a crane) that floats and reacts to scroll/mouse using <PresentationControls>.

Construct the requested sections: Mobile Cranes, Tower Cranes, Helicopter Lifting, Heavy Haulage, Lift Studies, Locations, About Us. Group these cleanly using the numbered chapter format: [01] MOBILE CRANES.
Use a slow editorial Marquee section between major layout blocks using framer-motion.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Avoid Shadcn UI entirely for the marketing page layouts; use raw Tailwind CSS classes in raw HTML tags (div, section) to get exact control of overlaps, offsets, and brutalist grid aesthetics.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). Never use completely transparent backgrounds for overlapping text elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Optical alignment over geometric alignment.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Do not use placeholder text for images. Use the provided image URLs.
